<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>false</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_snc_aegis_application</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>AEGIS Extract Resume Text</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {

    var attachmentGR = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
    attachmentGR.addQuery('table_name', 'x_snc_aegis_application');
    attachmentGR.addQuery('table_sys_id', current.sys_id);
    attachmentGR.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
    attachmentGR.setLimit(1);
    attachmentGR.query();

    if (attachmentGR.next()) {

        var gsa = new GlideSysAttachment();

        var content = gsa.getContent(attachmentGR);

        if (content) {

            current.resume = content.substring(0, 8000);

            current.update();

        }
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>DEEPTHI</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-21 19:55:49</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>054aaa98ed6f43107f446c21b633cf34</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AEGIS Extract Resume Text</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="AEGIS" source="x_snc_aegis">f1f4accb05d743107f44294ed7486a97</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="AEGIS">f1f4accb05d743107f44294ed7486a97</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_054aaa98ed6f43107f446c21b633cf34</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>DEEPTHI</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-22 04:26:56</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=054aaa98ed6f43107f446c21b633cf34"/></record_update>
